The Cal-Adapt: Analytics Engine hosts a variety of climate data. Many of these datasets have been converted to cloud-optimized formats and are available for download from our Amazon S3 bucket. Below is a summary of each dataset, including its source, download link, description, and where to learn more.

::: {.callout-note}
Sea Level Rise and Hydrologic Data are available for independent download but are not currently integrated into the Analytics Engine tools.
:::


## Climate Model Data

Downscaled climate projections produced for California's Fifth Climate Change Assessment, fully integrated into the Analytics Engine's Data Catalog and `climakitae` tooling. See the [Climate Model Data](../climate-model-data.qmd) page for full details on models, downscaling methods, and scenarios.

### WRF
![](../../assets/dataset-icons/wrf_t2_d03_2030.gif){.dataset-thumb}

Source
:   UCLA

Direct Download
:   <https://cadcat.s3.amazonaws.com/index.html#wrf/ucla/>

Description
:   8 unique models downscaled at 45 km, 9 km (WECC region), and 3 km (California) resolution. Primarily SSP3-7.0, with limited SSP2-4.5/SSP5-8.5 runs. Native hourly resolution, plus a WRF-ERA5 historical reanalysis.

Learn More
:   [Climate Model Data](../climate-model-data.qmd)

### LOCA2
![](../../assets/dataset-icons/loca2_tasmax_2030.gif){.dataset-thumb}

Source
:   Scripps Institution of Oceanography

Direct Download
:   <https://cadcat.s3.amazonaws.com/index.html#loca2/ucsd/>

Description
:   15 unique models downscaled at 3 km resolution over California. Available for SSP2-4.5, SSP3-7.0, and SSP5-8.5. Bias-corrected for all models, at native daily resolution.

Learn More
:   [Climate Model Data](../climate-model-data.qmd)

## Climate Reanalysis Data (ERA5)
Source
:   UCLA (dynamically downscaled reanalysis)

Access
:   <https://cadcat.s3.amazonaws.com/index.html#wrf/ucla/era5/>

Description
:   ERA5 historical climate reanalysis dataset, dynamically downscaled at 45 km, 9 km (WECC region), and 3 km (California) resolution to match the WRF grid. Available at daily and hourly resolution. Provides an observationally-constrained historical reconstruction, useful for studying the historical record or specific meteorological events like heatwaves and droughts.

Learn More
:   [Climate Model Data](../climate-model-data.qmd)


## Climate Profiles
![](../../assets/dataset-icons/tmy_icon.png){.dataset-thumb}

Source
:   Cal Adapt

Direct Download
:   <https://cadcat.s3.amazonaws.com/index.html#climate-profiles/>

Description
:   Annualized hourly climate profiles at HadISD station locations, including Typical Meteorological Year, Standard Year, and Extreme Climate Profiles datasets.

Learn More
:   [Climate Profiles](/scientific-guidance/climate_profiles/index.qmd)

## Historic Weather Station Data
![](../../assets/dataset-icons/hdp_icon.png){.dataset-thumb}

Source
:   Eagle Rock Analytics

Direct Download
:   <https://cadcat.s3.amazonaws.com/index.html#histwxstns/>

Description
:   Historical weather stations for the WECC region (approx. 15k stations), including the HadISD stations. Covers 1980 to 2022 and includes multiple variables.

Learn More
:   [About Climate Projections](/scientific-guidance/about-climate-projections.qmd)


## Sea Level Rise
![](../../assets/dataset-icons/sea_level_icon.png){.dataset-thumb}

Source
:   Scripps Institution of Oceanography, U.C. San Diego

Direct Download
:   <https://cadcat.s3.amazonaws.com/index.html#hmet/>

Description
:   Hourly sea level rise projections generated for 13 tidal stations along the California coast and San Francisco Bay, covering 1950–2100.

Learn More
:   [CEC Hourly Sea Level Projections Data Adoption Justification Memo](https://www.energy.ca.gov/sites/default/files/2024-09/06_HourlySeaLevelProjections_DataJustificationMemo_Iacobellis_Adopted_v2_ada.pdf)


## Hydrologic Data
Source
:   NOAH-MP and VIC models

Direct Download
:   NOAH-MP: <https://wrf-cmip6-noversioning.s3.amazonaws.com/index.html#ben_temp/d03_3km/CEC/2_NOAH_MP_SIMULATIONS/>
:   VIC: <https://wrf-cmip6-noversioning.s3.amazonaws.com/index.html#lusu/CEC/VIC_SIMULATIONS/GCMs/>

Description
:   UCLA-generated daily hydrology data from VIC and NOAH-MP, forced with a subset of LOCA2-Hybrid and four non-bias-corrected WRF dynamically downscaled datasets.

Learn More
:   [CEC Hydrology Projections Data Adoption Justification Memo](https://www.energy.ca.gov/sites/default/files/2025-04/05_HydrologyProjections_DataJustificationMemo_BassEtAl_Adopted_v3_ada.pdf)
